en: Clair
Wait!
I'm sorry about before. Here. Take this as my apology.
text: Îmi pare rău pentru data trecută. Ia asta, ca scuză.

en: That's Dragon Pulse. It's... a sort of great surge of energy. You don't have to use it if you don't want to.
text: Asta e Dragon Pulse. E... un fel de val uriaș de energie. Nu ești obligat să-l folosești dacă nu vrei.

en: If you're heading for the Pokémon League, go back to New Bark Town and Surf east along Route 27.
text: Dacă mergi spre Liga Pokémon, întoarce-te în New Bark Town și navighează spre est pe Ruta 27, cu Surf.

en: Something in your face says you've unfinished business. Whatever comes next, don't you dare give up!
text: Pe fața ta se vede că ai ceva neterminat. Orice ar urma, să nu îndrăznești să renunți!

en: Clair
Hm? You're up early, with nothing to do already? I may have time to listen to you.
was: Hm? Ce e? Mă întorc la Arenă.

en: If you insist, we can swap numbers, too! What do you say?
Fine. Here's my number, {player}.
Registered Clair in the Pokégear.
I can battle you on Friday nights, if you insist!
You again? Friday nights, remember, if it's a battle you're after. Until then, let me train.
Hm? What is it? I'm on my way back to the Gym.
{rival}
...What? Yes, I'm training my Pokémon here. You can laugh at me now, but it has to be done.
My Pokémon aren't ready to beat you yet. I can't push them too hard. I have to be strict with myself to become the greatest Trainer.
...Whew. Learn to stay out of my way.
{rival}
...What? Have you come all this way to laugh at my training? Humph!
I came here to learn the Master's secrets, and he makes a mystery of everything. So I'm training my Pokémon here myself.
Lance
Hello, {player}! And you, too. We met at the Team Rocket hideout.
{rival}
You! Where have you been all this time? Prepare to lose. I challenge you!
Lance
Calm down. I was in a hurry then, and I'm sorry for it.
But I never turn down a challenger! How about a Double Battle?
{rival}
Humph! You can't beat me one on one, can you?
Lance
Come on, a Double Battle isn't so bad. {player}, you'll be on my side!
Clair
Well, then. You over there, will you team up with me?
{rival}
You can't be serious! Me, with that show-off in the strange costume? No way!
{player}! Come to my side! We'll beat Lance together!
Lance
Just as I expected. You two make quite a team.
Going alone is one way to aim for the top. But that isn't all there is to a Pokémon battle, though I don't suppose either of you needs reminding.
See you another time, {player}!
Clair
I must excuse myself. ...{player}, that was a fun battle. And that goes for you too, wise guy.
{rival}
{player}... It wasn't supposed to go this way. Anyway, I'm not giving up on beating you!
I'll train my Pokémon, and my own heart too. I'll come back as the toughest challenge you've ever had!
